exercise:
import base64
from pyasn1.codec.der import decoder, encoder
from pyasn1_modules import rfc2459, rfc5208, rfc5280, pem  # noqa: F401 - modules google-auth uses

CERT = (
    'MIIBNjCB3KADAgECAgIBZjAKBggqhkjOPQQDAjAkMSIwIAYDVQQDDBlsb2N1cy1wcm92ZW5hbmNlLWV4ZXJjaXNl'
    'MB4XDTI2MDEwMTAwMDAwMFoXDTM2MDEwMTAwMDAwMFowJDEiMCAGA1UEAwwZbG9jdXMtcHJvdmVuYW5jZS1leGVy'
    'Y2lzZTBZMBMGByqGSM49AgEGCCqGSM49AwEHA0IABKDTeVhc20+Z0PDw06lNxsPEBDjDf+PSYuZ0u3FJ6J051ijG'
    'y3+gzf8Ehd/G2vJJoIdXGgWBT2muITOhQ2UBCBcwCgYIKoZIzj0EAwIDSQAwRgIhAJSmxsGfEu5dbBTE6pYhPs3Q'
    'OtXDstkVentuirSOxwR8AiEA/ueDxlZQhZWwDmFsCi37STzK5pqSuIdrO328ZAXbEK4='
)
der = base64.b64decode(CERT)
cert, rest = decoder.decode(der, asn1Spec=rfc5280.Certificate())
assert not rest
assert int(cert['tbsCertificate']['serialNumber']) == 358
assert encoder.encode(cert) == der
legacy, _ = decoder.decode(der, asn1Spec=rfc2459.Certificate())
assert int(legacy['tbsCertificate']['serialNumber']) == 358

conditions: Principal accepts that PyPI owner account 'ilya' (upload rights) could not be tied to a person.
Principal accepts that 0.4.2 was uploaded outside CI (no workflow run found), so the PyPI files are tied to the tag only by the byte-for-byte source comparison.
Install pinned by version and hash once Locus has a hash-locked dependency set (D-29 step 5).

decision.rationale: No P28-listed origin found for maintainers, organization or funding; the Entity List, the rest of the Consolidated Screening List and the 1260H notice show no hit. All 132 wheel files are byte-identical to the v0.4.2 git tag; the sdist differs only in build metadata (setup.cfg, PKG-INFO, egg-info). The only other static findings are two sdist-only example scripts under tools/ (an OCSP client and an SNMP GET example) that use the network when run by hand and are not in the wheel. OSV lists no vulnerability for 0.4.2; the sandboxed import plus an X.509 decode/re-encode with rfc5280 and rfc2459 made no connection attempt.

notes: Pulled transitively by google-auth; not imported by Locus code paths (docs/development/deep-agents-harness.md section 8).
The exercise certificate is a public, self-signed test certificate generated for this inspection (no private key is stored).
